name: theme-accessibility-ready-checks
description: Playwright-based accessibility-ready checks for WordPress themes

scripts.setup: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d && npx tsx src/utils/wait-for-wp.ts
scripts.test:theme: npm run teardown; npm run setup && npm run theme:switch && npm test; npm run teardown
scripts.test:theme:keep: npm run setup && npm run theme:switch && npm test
scripts.theme:switch: test -z "$A11Y_THEME_SLUG" || docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T wordpress wp theme install "$A11Y_THEME_SLUG" --activate --allow-root --path=/var/www/html
